messages:
evan: :rotating_light: Sudden surge of 502/504s on hosted inference endpoints (text-gen) in ap-east since ~2025-09-03T13:12Z. Customers reporting intermittent failures and long tails. Opening thread to triage.
zoe: SLOs show P95 jumped from ~200ms -> 2.9s and error rate ~20% for /v1/generate in ap-east region. Runtime pools are healthy but gateway is returning upstream reset frequently.
priya: Looking at gateway logs: lots of 502 with reason "backend connection closed" and a batch of 403/401 from the token-lookup service for certain orgs. Also seeing a spike in memcache miss-rate for token cache.
ben-support: Support tickets incoming from Lendly (ticket 15102) and ShopFlow (ticket 15110). They said retries sometimes pass. They want ETA and workaround.
ops-bot: Incident declared at 2025-09-03T13:12:32Z; severity: high. PagerDuty alerted.
deploy-bot: No gateway/runtime/auth-service deploys in last 8 hours. Last control-plane change visible at 2025-09-03T12:45:00Z (token-cache-ttl change).
ev an: @zoe can you correlate token-cache-ttl change with miss spike?
zoe: Yes, there was a control-plane flag bumped at 12:45 that lowered token-cache TTL from 300s -> 30s to reduce memory usage. That change rolled out to ap-east at ~13:09 and memcache miss-rate spiked immediately. With many misses, auth service fell back to DB, causing high latency and some 403s for racey keys.
priya: Gateway behavior: when auth introspect is slow, gateway retries up to 3 times (default). Retries pile up and create connection churn to runtime backends, many rejections are "upstream closed" because runtime hit connection limits. So root chain looks like: aggressive TTL drop -> cache miss storm -> auth latency/backpressure -> gateway retries amplify -> runtime resets -> 502/504s.
ben-support: Shared interim note to customers: we've applied temporary mitigations and recommended bounded retries. Lendly asked for immediate ETA and whether request logs will be available.
sre-lead: Let's do low-risk mitigations first. Plan: 1) revert token-cache-ttl change for ap-east (region-scoped rollback) 2) reduce gateway retry count in ap-east from 3 -> 1 3) enable org-scoped bypass for top-priority customers (Lendly, ShopFlow) 4) increase memcache capacity temporarily to reduce misses. Assigning owners: @pri ya revert TTL, @zoe reduce retries + increase memcache, @ben-support coordinate comms.
priya: Rolling back TTL change now via control-plane: ```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/configs/token-cache-ttl -d '{"region":"ap-east","ttl":300}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP'``` 
-> applied, propagation started.
zoe: Patching gateway config: eu-west/ap-east region override for ap-east: max_retries 3 -> 1, upstream_timeout 30s -> 45s. Pushed config and reloaded proxies. Also increasing memcache node count from 4 -> 8 for ap-east cluster.
priya: Auth-service latency dropping after TTL rollback; introspect p95 down from ~820ms -> ~120ms. Memcache hit-rate recovering. Error rate decreased from 19% -> 2.8% in last 6m.
ben-support: Customer update: told Lendly and ShopFlow we've applied temporary mitigations and asked them to hold off on client retries for 30 min. They asked to be notified before any mitigations are removed.
osps-bot: Incident severity downgraded to medium at 2025-09-03T13:33:21Z.
sre-lead: Good. We need a postmortem. Collect timeline, control-plane flag diff, memcache capacity metrics, auth-service traces, gateway retry traces, and affected org list. Also include reproduction steps to validate fixes in staging.
zoe: Repro steps I used: in staging lower token cache TTL to 30s, then flood gateway with 600 concurrent auth-bearing requests for a short window while memcache is small, monitor memcache miss-rate, auth introspect p95, and gateway 502s. Sample script: ```bash
# step 1: set TTL low
curl -X POST https://controlplane.staging/configs/token-cache-ttl -d '{"region":"staging","ttl":30}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP'
# step 2: constrain memcache nodes
# (simulate small pool)
# step 3: flood gateway
for i in $(seq 1 600); do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-test" https://gateway.staging/v1/generate & done
# tail gateway and auth logs for misses / 502s
```
priya: Proposed action items: [1] Add canary and regional guardrails when changing token-cache TTL (owner: priya) [2] Add alert on memcache miss-rate > 5% and token-introspect latency > 200ms (owner: zoe) [3] Implement gateway retry circuit-breaker to cap retry amplification (owner: sre-lead) [4] Make org-scoped bypass a first-class, audited feature with TTL and auto-revert (owner: ben-support) [5] Revisit default token-cache TTL and memcache sizing calculation (owner: infra-team)
sre-lead: Assigning due dates: 1) priya 10d, 2) zoe 3d, 3) sre-lead 21d, 4) ben-support 14d, 5) infra-team 7d. We'll review in the postmortem meeting.
ben-support: I'll draft customer-facing RCA and wait for final timeline. Lendly wants a short summary now and a deeper RCA later.
ops-bot: Please upload logs/traces to s3://redwood-incidents/2025-09-03/2245678999. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
zoe: One last note  we should also audit recent control-plane flag changes across regions; there might be a gap in rollout visibility (owner: infra-team).
priya: Agreed. Also adding a reproducible script to the incident folder for engineering to validate regression.
sre-lead: Closing this mitigation thread; continue detailed discussion in the postmortem doc and collect action item owners into tracker. :white_check_mark:
